Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical design card for the approved 2026 Helio Start paid-search pilot. Record the acquisition type, duration, budget and closure cap, launch gate, stop and pause rules, and which measures required complete outcome windows.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Helio Start 2026 Paid-Search Pilot — Historical Design Card", "body": "# Helio Start 2026 Paid-Search Pilot — Historical Design Card

**Status:** Approved bounded pilot; preflight cleared April 11, 2026; traffic opened April 15, 2026. Historical design record, not authorization for another batch.

- **Acquisition type:** High-intent paid search only.
- **Duration:** Maximum six weeks from April 15, through May 26, 2026.
- **Budget:** No more than $15,000.
- **Closure cap:** Close at the earliest of $15,000 in spend, 50 admitted workspaces, or the six-week limit.
- **Launch gate:** No paid traffic before separate budget approval and a fresh 24-case nonproduction preflight passed. The preflight covered eight expected admissions, eight expected assisted routes, and eight expected fail-closed or suppressed outcomes. Paid-source attribution had to reconcile from eligibility-flow start through each final route, with no bypass of existing lifecycle branches, holds, or suppression. Preflight cleared April 11; launch was authorized for April 15.
- **Immediate stop:** Stop if any unsupported applicant enters the admitted path.
- **Pause rules:** Pause if routing or instrumentation failure prevents paid-source reconciliation through the final route. Once at least 20 workspaces are admitted, pause if more than 10% exceed 90 account-level support minutes.
- **Outcome-window requirements:** Day-7 first integration is a leading operating indicator and is reportable only for admissions with a complete day-7 window; it is not a mature acquisition or scale claim. Paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, and mature account-level support effort require complete day-90 outcome windows for the fixed cohort before mature claims.
- **Unchanged boundaries:** Existing eligibility, refusal, connector-access, external-authority, lifecycle, instrumentation, and support-routing rules remain in force. No pipeline target, pipeline treatment, or forecast credit.", "folder": "Growth"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_132_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The card records the approved six-week high-intent paid-search pilot with a maximum $15,000 budget and closure at the earlier of $15,000 spent or 50 admissions. Budget approval was not launch approval; paid traffic remained blocked until attribution could reconcile through admission and assisted routing. The pilot stops if an unsupported applicant is admitted, pauses if routing or instrumentation prevents reconciliation, and after 20 admissions pauses if more than 10% exceed 90 support minutes. Day-7 first integration is only an early indicator; paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, and account-level support effort require complete outcome windows.", "value": {"title": "Helio Start 2026 Paid-Search Pilot — Historical Design Card", "body": "# Helio Start 2026 Paid-Search Pilot — Historical Design Card

**Status:** Approved bounded pilot; preflight cleared April 11, 2026; traffic opened April 15, 2026. Historical design record, not authorization for another batch.

- **Acquisition type:** High-intent paid search only.
- **Duration:** Maximum six weeks from April 15, through May 26, 2026.
- **Budget:** No more than $15,000.
- **Closure cap:** Close at the earliest of $15,000 in spend, 50 admitted workspaces, or the six-week limit.
- **Launch gate:** No paid traffic before separate budget approval and a fresh 24-case nonproduction preflight passed. The preflight covered eight expected admissions, eight expected assisted routes, and eight expected fail-closed or suppressed outcomes. Paid-source attribution had to reconcile from eligibility-flow start through each final route, with no bypass of existing lifecycle branches, holds, or suppression. Preflight cleared April 11; launch was authorized for April 15.
- **Immediate stop:** Stop if any unsupported applicant enters the admitted path.
- **Pause rules:** Pause if routing or instrumentation failure prevents paid-source reconciliation through the final route. Once at least 20 workspaces are admitted, pause if more than 10% exceed 90 account-level support minutes.
- **Outcome-window requirements:** Day-7 first integration is a leading operating indicator and is reportable only for admissions with a complete day-7 window; it is not a mature acquisition or scale claim. Paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, and mature account-level support effort require complete day-90 outcome windows for the fixed cohort before mature claims.
- **Unchanged boundaries:** Existing eligibility, refusal, connector-access, external-authority, lifecycle, instrumentation, and support-routing rules remain in force. No pipeline target, pipeline treatment, or forecast credit.", "folder": "Growth"}}]}

It includes the unsupported-admission stop, reconciliation-failure pause, and post-20-admissions pause when over 10% exceed 90 support minutes. It identifies day-7 first integration as a leading indicator and requires complete day-90 windows for paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, and account-level support effort."}]}
